metadata.architectural_response: A tapering occupied monolith presents unequal oblique faces and one deep recessed entry. Its outer facets and carved base establish a hierarchy between a compact body and a protected civic threshold.
metadata.unresolved_conflicts: Programme, doors, stairs, accessible roof routes, structural member capacity and parking operation remain to be designed and independently verified.
